name: friendly_resolution
description: A quick, friendly call where the agent resolves a minor billing question. No violations, low risk.
transcript:
Agent: Good morning, thank you for calling Jio support. This is Rahul. How can I help you today?
Customer: Hi Rahul, I just had a quick question about my bill. I see a charge of 49 rupees for a value-added service, but I don't remember subscribing to anything.
Agent: I'd be happy to help you with that. Could you please share your mobile number so I can check your account?
Customer: Sure, it's 9123456789.
Agent: Thank you. Let me pull up your account... I can see the charge. It's for a caller tune service that was activated on the 15th of last month. Would you like me to deactivate it and reverse the charge?
Customer: Yes, please! I must have accidentally activated it.
Agent: No problem at all. I've deactivated the caller tune service and initiated a refund of 49 rupees. It will reflect in your next billing cycle. Is there anything else I can help you with?
Customer: No, that's perfect. Thank you so much, Rahul. You were really helpful.
Agent: Thank you for calling, and I'm glad I could help. Have a wonderful day!
